label: hard-chair-held-out-set1
notes: Same plastic chair as hard-chair-set2, but the phone was held out in front and read, not pressed to the chest. Upright (lean 2 to 9 degrees). The arms damp the impact: stop time 0.22 s against 0.14 s, bounce ratio 0.13 against 0.26. Use it as an example of a decoupled phone, not as a reading of the chair. User agent removed, t rebased to trace start.
